name: Secure Admin Email Change
author: Priyank Sukhadiya

sections.description:
Change WordPress admin email instantly without email confirmation. Perfect for localhost, staging sites, or servers without email configuration.

Key Features:

  • Change admin email instantly without confirmation
  • Works without SMTP or outbound email
  • Built-in test email feature
  • Perfect for localhost and staging environments
  • Secure – admin-only access
  • No external services required

Use Cases:

  • Localhost development
  • Staging and testing sites
  • Sites without email configuration
  • Quick admin email changes

All processing happens locally on your WordPress site. Only administrators can change the site admin email.

Installation Instructions

  1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate via Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Go to Settings → General
  4. Update the admin email and click Change Email
sections.faq:
How do I change the admin email?

Go to Settings → General, update the “Administration Email Address” field, and click Change Email. No confirmation needed.

Does this work on localhost?

Yes! Perfect for localhost where email is often disabled.

Is this secure?

Yes. Only administrators can change the email. All processing is local, no external services used.

Do I need SMTP configured?

No. The plugin works without any email configuration.

What’s the test email feature?

You can send a test email to verify the new address works before making the change.
